ai_claim.claim: Recommendation/personalization ML is established production baseline; generative ad/production tools are incremental capabilities.
ai_claim.scope: streaming experience and selected advertising/production workflows
ai_claim.limitation: No isolated incremental retention, contribution or cash result.

strongest_counterevidence.claim: Disney and YouTube and short-form/video platforms competing for attention and advertisers can replicate tools or force gains through to customers.
strongest_counterevidence.limitation: Competitive capability does not by itself prove equal outcomes.

rights_limit: Netflix owns or licenses content rights by title, territory and window; viewing data are subject to privacy rules. Talent contracts and licensed content do not imply training rights.
materiality_summary: 5% of approximately $13.329bn FY2025 operating income is $666m.
